voice-author-notes-pollution.notes: P3 (agent names) fired on '(Claude Code, Antigravity, …) so the agent has the MCP tools.' The criterion exists to keep an agent's own working notes out of scholarly prose. Here the harnesses ARE the content: this is step 2 of a prerequisites list for an agentic harness, and a step that will not say which harnesses carry the MCP tools cannot be followed. P3 has no way to tell a byline from subject matter.
